item.title: Hidden magnetism inside atoms may explain mysterious gamma rays
item.description: Scientists have long wondered why some atomic nuclei emit unexpectedly high numbers of low-energy gamma rays. A new experiment suggests hidden magnetism may be the cause.

item.title: A strange new quantum droplet can hold itself together
item.description: Two distinct types of quantum particles may form stable, self-contained droplets, challenging long-standing theories in quantum physics.
